veranderings.rede: What follows the colon is a full sentence quoted as speech, so under the AWS it starts with a capital.

veranderings.blok: Water wat uit die wolke val
veranderings.na: Neerslag kom in drie vorme voor:
veranderings.rede: 'Val in drie vorme' copies the English 'falls in three forms'; 'kom in drie vorme voor' is the idiomatic Afrikaans.
'Platslaan' is a separable compound verb and is written as one word in the infinitive.
